Title: Some Release Information for Vampire: the Eternal Struggle

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Vampire: the Eternal Struggle is scheduled for an August release. Each of the
minion card types will have its own border design.

Dark Sovereigns, the first expansion for V:TES, is scheduled for an August
release. The borders of the minion cards will match the new cards. It will
introduce the Ravnos and Giovannit clans, and will include a number of new
princes from the major cities of Europe, as well as vampires of the
Inner Circle.

Darkness Unveiled, the first V:TES novel, is scheduled for a September release.
It will be in hardback, with cover art by Dave McKean. The interior will be
two color, with new art by a number of V:TES artists.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
